description.value: Cha Don (茶檔) is a Chinese fast food spot in Richmond, BC — the name is Cantonese for 'tea stall,' suggesting a Hong Kong-style cha chaan teng offering quick, affordable Chinese and Chinese-Western dishes. Richmond's dense cycling network and large Cantonese-speaking community make it a natural stop for riders exploring the city. Details about the menu and setup are limited due to sparse online information.
